zh.l1: 六个 Agent 一起干活，你还在挨个切窗口看？
zh.l2: 浮屿把它们收进一座岛。悬停一下，用量和进度都在。
zh.l3: 跑完、出错、等你确认，岛会亮灯。
zh.l4: 拿不准的地方，它就在岛上问你。
zh.l5: 做完的会话一点就归档，再点一下，跳回对应的终端。
zh.l6: 离开电脑，进度推到手机上，回一句，它接着干。
zh.l7: QQ、微信、邮件的新消息，也在岛上看。
zh.l8: 开会前倒计时，点一下就入会。
zh.l9: 勾掉待办，顺手记一笔。鼠标移开，岛自己收起。
zh.l10: 写代码的时候，歌词跟着音乐，一个字一个字地亮。
zh.l11: 深色、浅色，还有几种液态玻璃，随你换。
zh.l12: 拖到屏幕边上，它自己吸附。
zh.l13: 想让岛显示点别的？让 Agent 写个插件，提交到插件市场，谁都能装。
zh.l15: 浮屿，Windows 上的桌面灵动岛。开源，免费。

en.l1: Six agents at work, and you're still switching windows to check on them?
en.l2: Fuyu puts them all on one island. Hover for usage and progress.
en.l3: Done, failed, or waiting: the island lights up.
en.l4: When an agent isn't sure, it asks you right there.
en.l5: Archive a finished session with one click. Click another to jump back to its terminal.
en.l6: Away from your desk? Progress goes to your phone. Reply, and it keeps going.
en.l7: New messages from QQ, WeChat and mail show up on the island too.
en.l8: A countdown before meetings. One click to join.
en.l9: Tick off a to-do, jot a note. Move the mouse away, and the island tucks itself in.
en.l10: While you code, the lyrics light up with the music.
en.l11: Dark, light, and a few kinds of liquid glass. Your pick.
en.l12: Drag it to the edge, and it snaps into place.
en.l13: Want the island to show something else? Have an agent write a plugin and submit it to the market, where anyone can install it.
en.l15: Fuyu. A dynamic island for the Windows desktop. Free and open source.
